issues.legal_issue: Whether allegations arising from a private property dispute, without alleging deliberate and knowing interference with a person’s property rights because of their Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe status, make out a prima facie offence under Sections 3(1)(v) and 3(1)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

Whether criminal proceedings under Sections 3(1)(v) and 3(1)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 should be quashed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure when the complaint does not establish the offences’ ingredients and amounts to an abuse of process.
